description: Biz, bilime, uzaya ve teknolojiye meraklı, keşfetmeyi seven gençlerden oluşan GeoGenç ekibiyiz! 🌍🛰️ MODIS uydu verilerini kullanarak Dünya üzerindeki kritik noktaları belirlemeyi ve çevresel sorunlara çözüm üretmeyi hedefliyoruz. Ekibimizde yaratıcılığa, dayanışmaya ve yeni fikirler öğrenmeye önem veriyoruz. Araştırmayı seven, yaratıcı düşünen, takım çalışmasına yatkın; kodlama, harita, veri analizi veya tasarım alanlarına ilgi duyan takım arkadaşları arıyoruz!
summary: We developed a Smart Forest Fire Early Warning System that combines NASA MODIS and VIIRS satellite data with a four-function ground device. The device performs planned water spraying in high-risk zones, generates carefully selected deterrent sounds to guide people and animals to safety, detects sudden temperature and smoke changes with onboard sensors, and streams live 360° camera imagery to response teams for remote verification.By fusing satellite hotspot detections with real-time ground observations, the system enables earlier confirmation of fires and faster information sharing with authorities. This multi-layered approach helps limit fire spread, reduces risk for firefighters, protects ecosystems and oxygen-producing forests, and supports communities living near wildfire-prone areas.The project is important because forest fires are increasing worldwide. Faster detection and smarter ground tools can significantly reduce damage and save lives, forests, and the environment for future generations.
details:
Our project is a Smart Forest Fire Early Warning System that combines NASA MODIS and VIIRS satellite data with a four-function ground device to reduce the damage caused by increasing wildfires.

The system works as follows: Heat and smoke sensors on the ground device detect sudden temperature rises or changes in smoke density. These alerts are cross-verified with active fire data from NASA FIRMS (MODIS and VIIRS). Once confirmed, a 360° camera streams live imagery to response teams. The device also performs planned water spraying to raise humidity and lower ignition risk of dry vegetation, and generates carefully selected deterrent sounds to guide people and animals away from danger. All data is collected on a web dashboard.

Benefits include earlier detection, reduced risk for firefighters, limited fire spread, and better protection of forest ecosystems and oxygen production.

The intended impact is to reduce forest loss, increase safety for people and property, and help leave a healthier environment for future generations in Türkiye and other fire-prone regions.

We used only HTML for the development of the project. Hardware components include heat/smoke sensors, a 360° camera, and a water-spraying mechanism.

The creative aspect lies in not only monitoring satellite data but combining it with four physical ground functions to create a full “detect – verify – support response” chain. Our team considered factors such as the need for early detection, the safety of field teams, animal welfare, efficient use of water resources, and the system’s adaptability to different geographies.
